aviation_incidents.headline: 尾流亂流是什麼 航空網站說明成因與飛安影響
aviation_incidents.summary: 航空新聞網站Aerospace Global News刊出一篇說明性文章，解釋尾流亂流（wake turbulence）如何形成，以及它對飛行安全的影響。文章指出，飛機起飛、飛越上空或進場落地時，會在身後留下肉眼看不見的擾動氣流，多數情況下很快消失，但在特定條件下足以影響另一架飛經當地的飛機。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Explainer: what wake turbulence is and how wake vortices affect flight safety
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Aerospace Global News published an explainer describing what wake turbulence is and how it affects flight safety. It says that when an aircraft takes off, flies overhead or comes in to land, it leaves behind an invisible trail of disturbed air, which most of the time quickly disappears without causing problems but in the right conditions can be strong enough to affect another aircraft flying through it.

aviation_incidents.headline: 青年運動疑襲利雅德機場 傳數十傷、多家航空停飛
aviation_incidents.summary: 外交消息人士向法新社透露，葉門叛軍「青年運動」（Houthis）今天疑似發射飛彈襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德（Riyadh）國際機場，傳出數十人受傷，目擊者形容航廈內部陷入恐慌。沙烏地官方並未證實任何最新攻擊行動或疏散事件。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Houthis suspected of missile strike on Riyadh airport; dozens reported hurt, airlines suspend flights
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Diplomatic sources told AFP that Yemen's Houthi rebels were suspected of firing a missile at Riyadh International Airport in Saudi Arabia on Saturday, with dozens of people reported injured and witnesses describing panic inside the terminal. Saudi officials have not confirmed any latest attack or evacuation.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 俄亥俄州未來論壇聚焦臺灣無人機產業 臺美將續建可信賴供應鏈
taiwan_aviation.summary: 美國俄亥俄州年度「未來論壇」（Future Forum）8日在東自由市（East Liberty）交通研發中心舉行，論壇以科技、基建與運輸製造為主題。臺灣專場聚焦半導體、無人機及輪胎科技，並探討自駕計程車、無人卡車與無人載具快遞貨運等交通科技發展。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Ohio Future Forum spotlights Taiwan's drone industry and supply-chain ties
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Ohio's annual Future Forum, focused on technology, infrastructure, and transport manufacturing, was held on the 8th at a transportation research center in East Liberty. The Taiwan session focused on semiconductors, drones, and tire technology, as well as developments including self-driving taxis, autonomous trucks, and uncrewed-vehicle delivery and freight.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航10月16日起調漲行李相關費用 最高漲幅約3成
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空近日公告，自今年10月16日起開立機票，將調整超額行李費、預購行李費，漲幅約1成多至3成，此外寵物託運費也有調整。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines to raise baggage-related fees from Oct 16, increases of up to about 30%
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines has announced that tickets issued from Oct 16 this year will be subject to adjusted excess baggage fees and pre-purchased baggage fees, with increases of roughly 10 percent to 30 percent, and pet carriage fees will also be adjusted.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺北101國慶展演登場 600臺無人機搭配煙火演出14分鐘
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北101國慶展演10日晚間10時登場，以「Onward Taiwan 一起點亮臺灣」為主題，結合煙火、建築燈光與雷射光束。中央社報導指出，展演全程約14分鐘，出動600臺無人機，以1分鐘煙火揭幕，接續10分鐘無人機主秀，最後是3分鐘煙火壓軸。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taipei 101 National Day show features 600 drones in 14-minute display
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: A National Day show at Taipei 101 began at 10pm on 10 October under the theme "Onward Taiwan," combining fireworks, building lighting and laser beams, according to Central News Agency reporting. The report said the full display ran about 14 minutes and used 600 drones, opening with one minute of fireworks, followed by a 10-minute drone main show and closing with three minutes of fireworks.

international_aviation.summary: 客艙技術已有投入服務的案例，涵蓋個人座椅溫控、OLED機上娛樂與座椅背數位服務。漢莎航空Allegris頭等艙與商務艙座椅可讓乘客調整座椅溫度，相關系統已提供於配備Allegris的飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa Seat Climate Controls Are Available as Air Canada’s OLED System Enters Service
international_aviation.summary_en: Cabin technologies already in service include individual seat climate controls, OLED in-flight entertainment and personalised seatback services. Lufthansa’s Allegris First and Business Class seats let passengers regulate their own seat temperature, and the system is available on Allegris-equipped aircraft.

international_aviation.headline: 回顧Air Europe：從蓋特威克包機航空到泛歐航空集團的興衰
international_aviation.summary: Air Europe於1979年5月4日從倫敦蓋特威克機場（LGW）展開營運，當時是一家英國包機航空公司，初期以波音737自蓋特威克出發。報導指出，該公司前一年以Inter European Airways之名成立，創辦人包括前Dan-Air主管Errol Cossey與Martin O'Regan，以及旅遊業者Intasun Leisure創辦人Harry Goodman。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Europe remembered: from Gatwick charter flights to a pan-European airline group
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Europe began flying from London Gatwick Airport (LGW) on 4 May 1979 as a British charter airline operating Boeing 737s, according to a retrospective by Aerospace Global News. The report said the carrier had been created the previous year as Inter European Airways by former Dan-Air executives Errol Cossey and Martin O'Regan, together with Harry Goodman, founder of tour operator Intasun Leisure.

international_aviation.headline: 臺中雙十國慶升旗 5架無人機垂掛國旗飛過府前廣場
international_aviation.summary: 臺中市政府今天上午舉辦雙十國慶升旗典禮，安排5架無人機垂掛國旗，以大雁編隊凌空展旗飛過府前廣場，成為典禮焦點。
international_aviation.headline_en: Taichung National Day ceremony features five drones carrying flags over plaza
international_aviation.summary_en: Taichung City Government held a Double Tenth National Day flag-raising ceremony this morning, arranging five drones to carry flags in a formation over the plaza in front of the city hall, which became the focus of the ceremony.
